nameJa: Video + Chat タイポグラフィ
headline: Video + Chat
prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Create ONE finished promotional image for the Chrome Web Store listing tile of an original browser extension named YouTube Live Chat Fullscreen. Canvas landscape 11:7, target 1760x1120. Original conceptual illustration, not a real screenshot.
Art direction: witty, extremely crisp modern Swiss editorial typography, near monochrome bright warm off-white #f5f1e7, ink black #181818 and a single rich red #f43a31. Strong asymmetric typographic composition, immaculate spacing, no gradients, no shadows, no 3D. Huge confident black headline on two lines at left, taking most of the canvas, rendered exactly "Video" on first line and "+ Chat" on second line. The plus sign is red. A tiny upper-left wordmark rendered exactly "YouTube Live Chat Fullscreen" in a sober sans-serif. Visual wit: four red fullscreen corner brackets at the boundary of the composition make the whole flat image feel like one large video surface. In the right-lower corner INSIDE that full-screen surface, a compact lively floating chat panel drawn with flat warm-white surfaces and clean black lines, roughly 27% of canvas width. Four black/red capsule avatar dots and generous short chat messages, rendered exactly "LET'S GO", "what a moment", "GG!", "one more!". Clear comment composer at its bottom says exactly "Say something..." with a red send-arrow icon. The video itself can be abstracted as a single tiny red play triangle near the top-right; the TYPE is the star, not a thumbnail or fake browser.
This should feel like an elegant indie cultural publication cover, smart and recognizable at 440x280, quiet but bold. Flat minimal graphic design, not corporate SaaS marketing, not childish.
Avoid: physical computer, monitor, device mockup, desk, room, Chrome or YouTube logos, fake store badge, rating stars, developer or streamer face, tiny illegible paragraphs, charts, dark gradient background, rounded app screenshot frame, top heading plus central screen template. No additional text. Keep margins generous and every word spelled correctly.
recompositionPrompt: Edit this exact conceptual promo image. Recompose the ENTIRE design into one moderately wide 11:7 aspect ratio rectangular image, 1760 pixels wide by 1120 pixels high (ratio 1.571, like 440x280, NOT a panorama). Output must have that 11:7 rectangular shape; do NOT add side bars, do NOT merely crop, do NOT squeeze or stretch the typography. Keep the same warm off-white, black, red Swiss graphic art direction. Enlarge the vertical breathing space and rearrange naturally: tiny extension name upper-left, two-line giant black "Video" and "+ Chat" headline occupying left 65%, compact black-outline chat with four messages and a clearly visible composer tucked into lower-right. Red fullscreen brackets in four corners of the 11:7 canvas; small red triangular play glyph upper-right. Preserve exactly the heading "Video + Chat", brand "YouTube Live Chat Fullscreen", messages "LET'S GO", "what a moment", "GG!", "one more!", and composer "Say something...". It is essential that the result is a complete 11:7 landscape store tile, not the source's very long 2.5:1 panorama. Make the type slightly smaller to create top/bottom space, and let the chat panel overlap the headline's negative space if helpful. Same elegant bright minimal design, no extra objects, no real logos, no store badges.
conceptNote: 温かい白と赤、巨大な文字と全画面の四隅で機能を表す。小さなチャットと入力欄を右下に配置したエディトリアルな構成。生成イラストであり実際のスクリーンショットではない。
